text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon has conquered the Arima 
Kinen! It's Hishi Amazon!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon, not bad at all...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Still, how do I put it... I guess my eyes 
just kept drifting to Narita Brian...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I-I totally get it! Why is that, even 
though Hishi Amazon came in first place?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Even when she loses, Narita Brian really 
is a "monster," isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...! *pant*, *gasp*, *pant*!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: (I got 1st place, I won! But—)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
(None of 'em are fired up for a 
one-on-one. The only thing they see is 
'Narita Brian'...!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Son of a bitch...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the entire crowd at Nakayama 
Racecourse somehow captivated by Narita 
Brian, the Arima Kinen came to a close—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Hishi Amazon simply said, "I'm 
heading back first," and left the 
racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though she had won the one-on-one 
duel she had so longed for, Hishi Amazon's 
expression remained stern.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A flicker of unease crossed my mind, and I 
hurried back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Hnnnnyyyaaaarrrrgh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon arriving at the academy, a familiar 
roar echoed all around.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Phew, haah, phew...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I...! Won the race, but lost the 
fistfight!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: But— So what if that's the case?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If you're frustrated, then run! Like hell 
I'm gonna let myself be swallowed by 
"Narita Brian" forever!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You never know how a showdown will go till 
you try!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shouting as if to convince herself, she 
sprinted up the uphill slope.
choice_data_list:
(These words... I feel like I've heard 
them somewhere before—)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
There's no such thing as anything being 
impossible from the start!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"You never know the outcome of a match 
until you give it a shot...!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: *pant, gasp, wheeze*...! *phew*...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those were the words she said before I 
scouted her, if I remember correctly. 
Captivated by that straightforwardness, I 
decided to scout her.
choice_data_list:
(She hasn't changed at all since back 
then.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She possesses the strength to keep 
fighting fearlessly, no matter what 
reality awaits her there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —If so, there was only one thing to say.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Alright, one more set...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ah!? Trainy!? When did you...
choice_data_list:
Let's enter the Arima Kinen again next 
year!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian will surely run in the Arima 
Kinen again next year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next time, we'll surely have a duel 
that'll leave everyone in awe. I know 
Hishi Amazon can do it! When I tell her 
that—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Train-boy, you...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Heheh, yeah!! Thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I talked it over with Hishi 
Amazon, and taking into account the 
aptitude for mile and middle distances she 
showed on the Tiara route—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We set our next target race as the Osaka 
Hai, and the one after that as the Yasuda 
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Train-boy. This is just a selfish 
request of mine, but..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'll take 1st place in both, without fail. 
I won't accept anything less!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Without that kind of resolve, you won't 
stand a chance against that "Monster," 
Narita Brian. Am I right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both resolved to take on the challenge 
with their eyes set solely on 1st 
place...!
